sentences.text: For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rajendra Nath Sinha

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Rajesh Kumar  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to remove the defects within three weeks.
The petitioner is apprehending her arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 307, 435/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of the DP Act.
As per FIR, all the accused persons including the petitioner committed torture and harassment of the daughter of the informant for non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He submits that the petitioner is the Gotni (Jeth) of the deceased.
He submits that the husband of the decesed is already Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66355 of 2022(2) dt.17-01-2023 in judicial custody.

He submits that similarly situated co- accused has already been granted bail by a Bench of this Court vide order dated 19.12.2022 passed in Cr. Misc.
No. 55868 of 2022.
He further submits that petitioner has no criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of this application.
Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner in the event of her arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Buxar Town P.S. Case No. 550 of 2021, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) devendra/-
